title: Jill's Dairy — EN/ES/FR (Chas McIvor)
style: Afro-folk fingerpicked acoustic guitar Spanish French language learning warm female vocal 96bpm brushed drums trilingual Zimbabwe dairy farm portrait quiet certainty
lyrics:
[Verse 1 - English]
Four in the morning. The dairy doesn't wait.
She moved through them easy. She knew every name.
Quiet in the way that real things are quiet.
Not because nothing is happening. Because everything is.

[Verse 2 - Spanish, with English translations]
Cuatro de la mañana. La lechería no espera. (Four in the morning. The dairy doesn't wait.)
Se movía entre ellas fácilmente. Conocía cada nombre. (She moved through them easy. She knew every name.)
Silenciosa de la manera en que las cosas reales son silenciosas. (Quiet in the way that real things are quiet.)
No porque no pase nada. Porque todo pasa. (Not because nothing is happening. Because everything is.)
Sabías dónde estabas con Jill. (You knew where you stood with Jill.)
Que era en tierra firme. (Which was on solid ground.)
No lo decía dos veces. (She didn't say it twice.)
No necesitaba hacerlo. (She didn't need to.)

[Chorus - French, with English translations]
La laiterie de Jill (Jill's dairy)
Dans les heures avant que le monde se réveille (In the hours before the world wakes)
La laiterie de Jill (Jill's dairy)
Où le vrai travail se fait dans l'obscurité (Where the real work gets done in the dark)
La laiterie de Jill (Jill's dairy)
Où la certitude est une habitude matinale (Where certainty is a morning habit)
Et les vaches rentrent à la maison (And the cows come home)
Parce que Jill est là (Because Jill is there)

[Bridge - all three]
English: Some people hold families together quietly. Jill did it quietly. Which is harder.
Spanish: Algunas personas mantienen las familias juntas en silencio. Jill lo hizo en silencio. Lo cual es más difícil. (Some hold families quietly. Jill did it quietly. Which is harder.)
French: Certaines personnes maintiennent les familles ensemble tranquillement. Jill l'a fait tranquillement. Ce qui est plus difficile. (Some hold families quietly. Jill did it quietly. Harder.)

[Outro - all three]
English: Jill's dairy — still running in the family it made
Spanish: La lechería de Jill — todavía funcionando en la familia que creó (Jill's dairy — still running in the family it made)
French: La laiterie de Jill — encore dans la famille qu'elle a créée (Jill's dairy — still in the family it made)
